title: When a base overlay reverts a file that defines a new helper used elsewhere, say in the brief that the package will not build, or give a two-file overlay

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-182242-2e66, project ork, item S572:

When a base overlay reverts a file that defines a new helper used elsewhere, say in the brief that the package will not build, or give a two-file overlay

Evidence: overlay-4.json reverted speccheck.go and the build failed with "undefined: heldNote" at launch.go:378, so the new speccheck test could not be shown red alone
